🛡️ Adaptive Risk Governance Matrix
Evaluates statistical heartbeat drift (sliding-window Z-Score, ±15% jitter margin) and geographical impossible travel (>950 km/h Haversine velocity or concurrent /24 subnets). Risk score >= 50 enforces a 5-minute re-attestation challenge; risk score >= 85 triggers automatic zero-trust quarantine.
● Nominal (0-49): Allowed
● Suspicious (50-84): Re-Attestation Challenge Required
● High Risk (85-100): Automatic Quarantine & Access Block

🔒 Hardware Enclave Architecture & Zero-Plaintext Guarantee
Enforces hardware-rooted trust via Intel SGX Quote v3/v4 ECDSA P-256 signatures and AMD SEV-SNP 1184-byte cryptographically signed attestation reports. Following mutual attestation, an ephemeral ECDH tunnel with RFC 5869 HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM is established. License tokens, entitlement tiers, and feature flags are evaluated inside the secure enclave memory with strictly monotonic sequence counters — the host hypervisor and broker transit layers never observe plaintext keys.
● Intel SGX: MREnclave (SHA-256) & MRSigner Verification
● AMD SEV-SNP: Launch Measurement & Guest Policy Bit 17 Enforcement
● Zero-Plaintext: Memory-Barrier Zeroization (`subtle.ConstantTimeCompare`)

🌐 Geo-Distributed Anycast Edge Routing & Sub-Millisecond L1 Cache
Dispatches global license verifications to the nearest healthy Point of Presence (POP) using Haversine spherical distance and dynamic active RTT telemetry. Sub-millisecond in-memory L1 cache serves license lookups under 100 microseconds with asynchronous Stale-While-Revalidate (SWR). During network partitions or upstream cloud outages, local emergency leases are generated with HMAC-SHA256 signatures, ensuring zero customer downtime.
● Ashburn (IAD): us-east
● San Jose (SJC): us-west
● Frankfurt (FRA): eu-central
● Tokyo (NRT): ap-northeast
● Singapore (SIN): ap-southeast
● Sao Paulo (GRU): sa-east

🛒 Marketplace & Reseller Webhooks Bridge (v1.8.0)
Automated payment and subscription lifecycle management for Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle. Inbound webhooks undergo constant-time HMAC signature verification (crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare / hmac.Equal), timestamp replay drift mitigation (±300s window), and thread-safe LRU idempotency caching. Successful purchases auto-provision licenses with instant tier and seat allocation; refunds, cancellations, and disputes trigger automated license revocation coupled with zero-latency Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream kill-switch pushes to sever running client sessions instantly.
● Stripe: /api/marketplace/webhook/stripe
● Lemon Squeezy: /api/marketplace/webhook/lemonsqueezy
● Paddle: /api/marketplace/webhook/paddle

🛡️ Hardware-Enforced Air-Gapped License Vault & Offline Dongle Emulation (v1.9.0)
Cryptographically secured offline license entitlement verification for isolated SCADA, defense, and high-security air-gapped industrial facilities. Offline dongle tokens are signed using high-assurance Ed25519 digital signatures and bundled into compact Base64/Hex envelopes or Base45-encoded QR code strings. The vault incorporates an anti-clock-rollback monotonic hardware counter check that trips and locks the license vault if local system time is manipulated backwards, with atomic recovery via administrative Ed25519 cryptographic signatures.
